summary: The second flash memory fab at Kioxia's Kitakami Plant in Iwate Prefecture, built on land east of Fab1. Construction began in April 2022, the building was finished in July 2024 and the fab began operating in September 2025, run jointly with Sandisk and partly funded by a Japanese government subsidy. It first made 8th-generation 218-layer flash and in July 2026 began producing the 10th generation, with capacity added in stages.

location.note: Built on the east side of the existing Fab1.

metrics.note: Subsidy for the Kioxia and Western Digital joint venture covering both the Yokkaichi and Kitakami plants.

milestones.note: Meaningful output was expected in the first half of 2026.
